: Three labeling scripts write new severity/presence
fields directly back into the L2 metadata registry (v2.4.0),
making it a living annotation system rather than read-only.
These fields are then consumed by prepare_multitask_datasets.py
(shadow/warping/merge sub-commands) in Stream 4C and by the
Unified Training Corpus (UTC) as per-head label sources.
